page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.1-8 is a flexible general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on x86_64 architecture. The instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 7J13 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. It provides 1 dedicated physical core mapped to 2 vCPUs via multithreading, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio.

The hardware configuration does not feature dedicated graphics hardware or integrated local storage drives, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data management and root disk operations. The virtual machine includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for external connectivity.

This entry-tier flex profile offers cost-efficient compute capacity for non-intensive production and development environments. Because compute and memory are allocated without bundled local storage or acceleration hardware, infrastructure spend remains strictly aligned to base processing resources. It is suited for lightweight web serving, application backends, small internal databases, and CI/CD worker nodes.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.1-8 is an entry-level general-purpose instance featuring 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7J13 processor running at 2.55 GHz, the configuration allocates 1 dedicated physical core with 2 execution threads. The instance includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address and does not come with integrated local storage or hardware accelerators, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system and application data. With a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, this flexible instance provides a resource-efficient baseline for lightweight web serving, microservices, small databases, and development environments.
